description: Ministry of Sports - Order to appoint Mr. S. E. R. T. M. S. P. Bandara as Competent Authorize Officer for the National Association of Badminton w.e.f. 19.04.2017
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Dayasiri Jayasekara, Minister of Sports) and outlines detailed responsibilities and actions taken under the Sports Act, including suspending a national association's registration and appointing a competent authority with specific functions. It contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/actions).
